description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://blizzard.example/bpmn/character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start character creation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start account setup and name ideation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBnetAccount" name="Check battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetCheck" name="Has battle.net account?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateBnetAccount" name="Create battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmBnetAccount" name="Confirm account via link in mail"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetMerge" name="Battle.net account available"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" name="Check active WoW subscription"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionCheck" name="Has active WoW subscription?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentSplit" name="Payment method?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCardInfo" name="Enter credit card information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterIBANNumber" name="Enter IBAN number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBICNumber" name="Enter BIC number"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Payment handled"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into game"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRealm" name="Select realm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRace" name="Select race"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectClass" name="Select class"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with character names"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AccountJoin" name="Account set up and names ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameMerge" name="Name entry"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter character name"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name available?"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SendSelfies" name="Send character selfies"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_ExpansionReleased" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotificationReceived" name="Expansion notification received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCheckBnet" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBnetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToComeUpWithNames" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBnetToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBnetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BnetCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetCheck" targetRef="Task_CreateBnetAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasBattleNetAccount == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BnetMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasBattleNetAccount == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateToConfirm" sourceRef="Task_CreateBnetAccount" targetRef="Task_ConfirmBnetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmToBnetMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmBnetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BnetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetMergeToSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionCheck" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasActiveWoWSubscription == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionCheck" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasActiveWoWSubscription == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPaymentToSplit" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInfo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentMethod == 'creditCard'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterIBANNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentMethod == 'bankAccount'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IBANToBIC" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBANNumber" targetRef="Task_EnterBICNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCardToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInfo" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BICToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBICNumber" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMergeToLogin" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToRealm" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectRealm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RealmToRace" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealm" targetRef="Task_SelectRace"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RaceToClass" sourceRef="Task_SelectRace" targetRef="Task_SelectClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClassToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectClass" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NamesToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToNameMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountJoin" targetRef="Gateway_NameMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameMergeToEnter" sourceRef="Gateway_NameMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterNameToCheck" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" name="Available" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nameAvailable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameTaken" name="Taken" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_NameMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nameAvailable == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToSelfies" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendSelfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfiesToExpansion" sourceRef="Task_SendSelfies" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionToEnd" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="EndEvent_NotificationReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
